newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA SHIPYARD STARTS OFFICIAL LIST AT 1.43 LATS.
newsitem.headline: RIGA SHIPYARD STARTS OFFICIAL LIST AT 1.43 LATS.

text.p: Riga Shipyard, which on Monday joined the official list of the stock exchange, was quoted at a price of 1.43 lats in a special quotation on the bourse, dealers said.
The price compared with the sale of an 8.37 percent stake in the firm for cash in April at 1.39 lats and a quote last week on the over-the-counter market at 1.45 to 1.47 lats.
In a special quotation, buy and sell orders can only be given for this session and there are no fluctuation limits.
Riga Shipyard joins Unibanka , Staburadze and Riga Transport Fleet on the official list.
Secondary list stock Kaija will join the official list from the secondary list tomorrow.
Riga Shipyard's 1996 profit came to 183,855 lats and it registered a first quarter loss of 51,220 lats.
Full results of the session and a press conference on the new listing will take place at 1300/1000 GMT.
